title: Sordland/Turn06/PSnW_EducationSpending
description: Overall overview of education. The President decides on education spending.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "After a meeting with the rector and..."
entries.dialogueText: After a meeting with the rector and a brief tour of the University of Valgen, we gathered in a room with Ciara.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The entire campus was visible from..."
entries.dialogueText: The entire campus was visible from the windows. Students were reading books, studying and having picnics under the trees.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "It reminded me of my own times at D..."
entries.dialogueText: It reminded me of my own times at Deyr University of Culture -- at least, the more carefree moments.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "It reminded me of my own times at H..."
entries.dialogueText: It reminded me of my own times at Holsord State University -- at least, the more carefree moments.

entries.speaker: Narrator

entries.dialogueText: It reminded me of my own times at Lachaven Business School -- at least, the more carefree moments.

entries.speaker: Ciara Walda
entries.title: Ciara Walda: "“Reminiscing about the past?”"
entries.dialogueText: “Reminiscing about the past?”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“It's nothing.”"
entries.dialogueText: “It's nothing.”
entries.menuText: “It's nothing.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Yes. It had its ups and downs but..."
entries.dialogueText: “Yes. It had its ups and downs but it was still fun.”
entries.menuText: “Yes. It had its ups and downs but it was still fun.”

entries.speaker: Ciara Walda
entries.title: Ciara Walda: "“And now we're growing old and bitt..."
entries.dialogueText: “And now we're growing old and bitter.”

entries.speaker: Ciara Walda
entries.title: Ciara Walda: "“The usual story. A few friends dea..."
entries.dialogueText: “The usual story. A few friends dead, a couple of them missing after the coups. Oh, and I was almost arrested once.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“How were your university years?”"
entries.dialogueText: “How were your university years?”
entries.menuText: “How were your university years?”

entries.speaker: Player

entries.dialogueText: “What for?”
entries.menuText: “What for?”

entries.speaker: Ciara Walda
entries.title: Ciara Walda: "“Protesting against police brutalit..."
entries.dialogueText: “Protesting against police brutality. Ironic, isn't it?”

entries.title: Player: "“No good memories? You should try t..."
entries.dialogueText: “No good memories? You should try to be a bit more optimistic.”
entries.menuText: “No good memories? You should try to be a bit more optimistic.”

entries.speaker: Player

entries.dialogueText: “We all went through tough times back then.”
entries.menuText: “We all went through tough times back then.”

entries.dialogueText: “It's difficult when there's nothing positive about those times. Also, being a pessimist makes me realise the problems quicker.”

entries.speaker: Ciara Walda
entries.title: Ciara Walda: "“Some of us more so than others.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Some of us more so than others.”

entries.speaker: Ciara Walda
entries.title: Ciara Walda: "“Let's not get sidetracked.""
entries.dialogueText: “Let's not get sidetracked."

entries.speaker: Ciara Walda

entries.dialogueText: “Unfortunately our fuel is running out at the Ministry of Education.”

entries.dialogueText: “The state having had to rely on privatization funds is a disgrace. We are letting private interests meddle in the most essential service; learning.”

entries.dialogueText: “It was very positive to see the administration dedicate the funding that was requested.”

entries.dialogueText: “Although I insist that the funds are still necessary to close the gaps in services, I can't say we have been entirely off track.”

entries.dialogueText: “It comes at a welcome surprise in Sordish politics to see a President uphold their promises regarding education.”

entries.dialogueText: “I am making sure that the additional funds are being used in the best way possible in order to resolve structural issues, speaking of.”

entries.title: Ciara Walda: "“Although you swore you would focus..."
entries.dialogueText: “Although you swore you would focus on education during your term, you have not lived up to that promise.”

entries.dialogueText: “Stagnation doesn't get anyone anywhere. Simply maintaining my ministry's funds got us sitting duck with the dozens of issues left unsolvable.”

entries.dialogueText: “The effects of your decision are much greater than I think you realise. The real damage is being done to the younger generation.”

entries.dialogueText: “I feel personally betrayed. You promised to focus on education during our term. And here we are suffering the consequences of a budget cut.”

entries.title: Ciara Walda: "“I'm trying very hard to look past..."
entries.dialogueText: “I'm trying very hard to look past that but can't really.”

entries.dialogueText: “And as you have already stated, improving Sordland's sexist and horrendously outdated education system is low on your priorities list.”
